methodology.disputed_definition: Distinct adopted Clem1598-USFX verses in HEAD with an open Pass 1 substantive proposal (newly restored native Vulgate verse, Stage 1 critical-text wording upgrade, fidelity/meaning edit, Rule 4 ambiguity note, disputed Messianic capitalization, proper-name review, or needs_human_editor=true) awaiting Pass 2 independent verification and application.
methodology.unverified_definition: Adopted Clem1598-USFX verses not audited in Pass 1 (0 across all 70 books).
